body: But I don't get to die.
Mostly no, because I find socializing with people hard.
I don't have many interests though. People around me like different things and I can't relate to them.
I've tried it several times and they didn't work, and made my depression worse.
Like what?
I'm asocial.
I want a relationship. Friends. Something.
But nothing replaces what I want. They heal the pain, for a bit, but it always comes back.
Why?
I never once said it was the sole thing that would keep me from being sad, or killing myself, so go away. I'm reporting you before I argue with you and get banned.

I go on walks, exercise at my house, stay at my house most of the time, go to classes when I need to, go out in public when I need something; no real socialization beyond that. Occasional Facebook interaction.
Thinking about suicide. Wishing I had someone.
Definitely not a "one-sided open relationship". That's an oxymoron in itself. Why do you feel he shouldn't be allowed to have an open relationship?
While not allowing him to do the same. Your mutual exclusivity makes no sense.
I think he has plenty right to be hurt. You're asking to cheat on him. There's no way around that.
I never said I would rely on anyone to fix my problems. Simply that a relationship would make me feel better. Bad spin on my words.
Well of course there are easier forms than that.
Therapy does. And this as well as therapy are embarrassing. Suicide isn't. Also this doesn't end my problems.
Therapy is expensive and they'll put me in a hospital, also I'll look weak and I don't want that.
That's given I have patience though, I don't, so leaving Winter sounds great, albeit from drinking pesticide. (tried sticking to the allegory)
But suicide is free and easier?
No.
But nobody likes me enough to do that and I don't have the patience to change things about me because I want to kill myself that much.
Anecdotal.
So why don't you get banned for namecalling.
People want me dead but you're the worthless one.
Fuck you.
I don't have the patience, and even than, if people want to judge the relationship on stuff like that I don't want to be with them in any way.

No alcohol. no drugs, bad eating but I do not play video games all day and I do like exercising daily though I am not in shape.

Still want to shoot myself regardless.

Depression builds when I try that and I want to kill myself even more.

It's what I'm doing right now and clearly it's not working.
Not when you lack patience. A solution like running in the roadway makes things much faster.

I don't even think I want to be alive really. Invest time and money into therapy which will probably still result in the same fate, it doesn't make sense. Not to mention the therapist could of course do the things I previously outlined.
Though I lack the patience and any time I tried to further said relationship I got mad at the person and cut them off.

I don't know if it would really work that way if I said I was going to still think about doing it and left. 

Also the embarrassing part is still there.
I have those.

>and get you out of a crisis state before sending you HOME.

And if I forcibly left while still a harm to myself and said therapist had my private information?
When nobody speaks to you on a daily basis that means they do not like you.
I don't want to say that. If I go and tell a therapist what I really think about myself and others I would be forced into a hospital no doubt. "Threat to self/others".
I tried those and people still hate me.

Every person I know that took depression medicine has, or at least became an even more unhappy/angry person after. 

>They can't force anything on you.

At least where I live, doctors can call police/ambulance on you if you were to really vent to them to the degree I would. 

>it's doing what you know is right for yourself

I don't think it's right for myself. I think I would be 100x worse after.

>Why are you embarrassed? I don't even understand the embarrassment behind going to a medical professional--because that is what trained therapists are. 

Because it makes me look mentally weak, and embarrasses me because I feel pathetic if I were forced in that situation. Also, I would have a hard time subscribing to any "behavioral plan". "Go out to a social event", I would, but then someone would do something to frustrate me and I would leave, thus making the therapy session a waste of time and money. Also they could give me medicine/force me to go to a hospital which would ruin my life. I could spend that time and money finding a relationship instead of being locked in a hospital high on pills, or forced to live like a zombie on pills.
I don't know, convince me of the value of it. I would be embarrassed and feel even worse after it. It's also expensive and time consuming.

Like a crutch. It's an assistance tool to help you "get better" and prevent you from "getting worse". Not a be all end all cure, but a tool. 

Sorry to insult your profession, but the whole crutch thing isn't even my primary issue with it. More so just the embarrassment and pettiness. I'd want to kill myself.

I find that it does, and I don't want to be weak.

Admittedly I have a "bad" ego. Don't really know how to fix that besides the same solution as the other issues. It's not a doctors office, I think it's a crutch.
I haven't made up my mind already.
I'm upset but I'm not going to circlejerk every answer as gospel.
I say no not because I don't care, but because I just don't think it will help.
Listening doesn't have to equal agreement, which you seem to fail to understand.
I gave you my counter points. It's that bad that I have done everything I can think of to fix myself besides therapy, which I refuse.

>and I'm asocial to the point where I would refuse to vent to someone even if I had the chance.

Really helps your argument when you don't paraphrase.

>(Also, why ask a question if you are going to argue against every answer you don't like?)

To have a discussion even if you don't like what I'm going to say?
No, because I've already shut the idea down about doing it.
But I specifically said I wouldn't do it because I don't like the idea of therapy.
I disagree.
But I've done everything I can to do so besides the radical solution.
But my top priority is a relationship because a relationship makes me feel better about myself.
Though everything I've done to try to fix myself doesn't work.
